snapshot.title: NAS Recovery Verification Plan — Calibration Share Confirmed

fields.subject: FW: Verification Plan for NAS Recovery
fields.note: The MSSP has confirmed the environment is clean and the offline drive OB-1 is free of malicious artifacts. The verification protocol under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3 has been fully executed. The calibration share is now accessible only via the clean machine and the offline drive. All steps are documented in the incident folder. The IC and GM must approve before any network reconnection. No media release is permitted until the GM authorizes.

original.subject: Final Verification: Calibration Share Integrity — OB-1 Mounted on DC-LOGIN01
original.body:
Subject: Final Verification: Calibration Share Integrity — OB-1 Mounted on DC-LOGIN01

The MSSP has completed the full forensic scan of the offline drive OB-1 (10.17.60.17). No malicious artifacts were detected. The drive was mounted on a clean machine (DC-LOGIN01, 10.17.60.1) with no network access.

The verification script (verify_manifest.py) was executed manually and passed for all 147 calibration files in \HUOG-NAS01\controlled\calibration\.

The calibration share is now accessible only via the clean machine and the offline drive. No network connection is active.

This completes the verification protocol under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead must approve the next step before any data is reconnected to the network.

— SecureWatch MSSP, Incident Response Team

Attachment: SOC-2026-0420-002 (Verification Report)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms that the recovery verification is complete and the calibration share is clean. The PIO must not confirm any details to media or public until the GM authorizes. Watch for premature media statements.
